A great quick weeknight dinner is **One-Pan Lemon Garlic Chicken with Broccoli & Rice**:

- **Protein**: Boneless chicken thighs (cook faster than breasts, stay juicy)
- **Veg**: Broccoli florets (roast on same pan)
- **Flavor**: Lemon slices, garlic, olive oil, oregano, salt/pepper
- **Base**: Microwaveable rice pouch (90 sec)

**Method**: Toss chicken + broccoli with oil, garlic, oregano, lemon, S&P on sheet pan. Roast 400°F / 200°C for 22–25 min. Heat rice. Done in ~30 min with minimal cleanup.
